text_block_list.text:
"February arrived, and on one bitterly 
cold day that showed no sign of easing—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer! Can I ask you a 
question?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, which do you prefer— "sweet" or 
"bitter"?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, just answer the 
question. I've got plenty of other things 
to ask you."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mayano says adults like things "bitter", 
but is that true for you too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Then make it bitter for me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm... Well then, on to the next 
question.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Do you prefer heart-shaped ones? Or are 
you totally fine with other shapes too?
choice_data_list:
Are you talking about Valentine's 
chocolates?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whaaahaa~~!? How did you know!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"And here I was trying to surprise you 
with a present, too!"

Realizing that you were thinking about 
that for my sake makes me feel terribly 
guilty...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that I'm caught, nothing I can 
do.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you chocolate for Valentine's 
Day, so just keep answering the questions, 
okay?

"And then, I answered questions about my 
favorite kind of chocolate, toppings, and 
so on—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, now I've got Trainer's tastes 
down perfectly! Just look forward to the 
big day!
And on Valentine's Day...
...Just as the clock struck midnight—
(THUMP-THUMP-THUMP-THUMP!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, but it was supposed to be a 
surprise, so I was frustrated that you 
found out right away.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You were surprised, so it's a huge 
success! Ah, that was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I need to hurry back to the 
dorm. See you tomorrow... ah, see you 
later today~!

Thanks to Tokai Teio's spirit of surprise, 
it turned into an unforgettable 
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well then, final question!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make the chocolates you just 
mentioned, but... would you prefer 
store-bought ones instead?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yeah, got it! Look forward to the 
big day!
And then, the day of Valentine's arrived—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on, eat, eat! It's handmade chocolate 
made just the way you like it, Trainer!

"I popped one of the cute, heart-shaped 
bite-sized chocolates into my mouth."

The taste of mild, subtly sweet chocolate 
spreads through your mouth, and then... a 
kick of wasabi follows?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You already ate the "wasabi 
chocolate"?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's Russian Roulette chocolate! 
Surprised, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because I wanted to surprise you! Don't 
worry, the rest are totally normal ones♪

Between the fact that Tokai Teio made it 
by hand and the sheer shock of the wasabi 
chocolate, it turned out to be an 
unforgettable Valentine's Day.
